User supplied implementation reference excerpts for `observational-memory`: Phase A short-term observations in branch-local ledger with `/tree` rollback, and Phase B file-backed topic/index/journey memory previously shared at project `.memory/`; provides architecture, code excerpts, tests, README and plan for subsequent implementation.

Reference design specifies ordinary recorded headless Pi worker sessions spawned via bespoke child_process; observer returns atomic observations through `.memory/.runs` IPC, consolidator edits scoped memory files, and orchestrator handles timestamps, ledger commits, tombstones, compaction rendering and TUI.

Reference implementation includes session gate default OFF with `/om` controls, observer/consolidator/compaction triggers, worker cost tracking, journey and memory-map rendering, plus ledger folding and timeline/status UI. The requested later change must adapt all durable memory and worker IPC paths to per-session roots while preserving ledger semantics.

Supplied tests cover compaction cutoffs and observer waiting, scoped consolidator tools, cost accounting, timestamp assignment and ledger folding; these are reference coverage areas for the later implementation.
